headline: Japan's Takaichi may struggle to soothe voters and markets - Latest News
summary: Japanese stocks rose to record highs on Monday after Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's election triumph. Experts warned she may struggle to keep both voters and markets satisfied.
why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark index of major listed companies, and its direction reflects investor views on Japanese policy and corporate earnings.
why_moved: Stocks rallied after Prime Minister Takaichi's election victory, which lifted investor sentiment about Japan's political direction.
